name: Visual Studio
description: Builds and reads errors in a running Visual Studio through its MCP server (VS-MCPServer extension, Tools > MCP Server > Start Server).
_comment_enabled: OFF as shipped. Switching it on lets a model build your open solution and read its Error List.
_comment_timeout: A build can take a while; a tool call waits this many seconds.
_comment_allow: Only these tools reach the model. The server offers ~56 (documents, editor, the whole debugger); a local model shown dozens calls them instead of answering, and each one is a thing a model can do on your desktop. Edit files through the `files` adapter instead: it keeps backups and shows the diff. `genghis_coordinator.py adapters` names any tool here the server does not have.
_comment_node: Visual Studio's server listens on this machine only. Add "node": "<fleet id of the PC running Visual Studio>" when the chat is answered by another box.
